import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import { Globe, ShieldAlert, FileSearch, Lock, Cpu, Server, Terminal, ShieldCheck, Github, Linkedin, Twitter, ExternalLink, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react'; export default function LandingPage() { const navigate = useNavigate(); const [matrixCols, setMatrixCols] = useState([]); useEffect(() => { const cols = Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i, left: `${i * 4}%`, duration: `${Math.random() * 5 + 3}s`, delay: `${Math.random() * 3}s`, text: generateRandomBinary() })); setMatrixCols(cols); }, []); function generateRandomBinary() { const chars = "01NET_SENTINEL[SOC]#$_-SEC"; let str = ""; for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) { str += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)) + " "; } return str; } const handleToolClick = (moduleName) => { const storedUser = localStorage.getItem('netsentinel_user'); if (!storedUser) { navigate('/login', { state: { from: moduleName, message: 'Authentication Required: Please login before accessing NetSentinel threat tools.' } }); } else { navigate('/dashboard', { state: { defaultModule: moduleName } }); } }; return (

NET_SENTINEL
{/* HERO SECTION */}
SYSTEM SIMULATION ONLINE // SEC_OPS ACTIVE

NETSENTINEL SOC INTELLIGENCE SUITE

A modular threat intelligence platform engineered for real-time network probes, host telemetry resolution, active CVE vulnerability detection, and exposed asset audits.

{/* ABOUT PROJECT SECTION */}

PROJECT ARCHITECTURE & DESIGN PURPOSE

NetSentinel SOC provides security analysts and administrators with direct visibility into external network footprints. Featuring live simulations and real-time backend API integration, operators can execute vulnerability assessments with instant telemetry feedback.

⚡ Live API Pipeline

Queries live authoritative endpoints including Shodan InternetDB and IP geolocations.

🛡️ Auth Gate Protection

Requires authenticated analyst sessions before executing security probes.

📊 Audit Logging

Persists scan results and enables instant JSON vulnerability report exports.

{/* HORIZONTAL SLIDING TOOL MODULES CARDS */}

RECONNAISSANCE TOOL MODULES

Swipe or scroll horizontally to browse simulation tools. Click any card to launch.

{/* Tool 1 */}
handleToolClick('host_info')}>

1. Domain Host & IP Geolocation Intel

Resolves target domains to IPv4 addresses. Fetches ASN details, ISP providers, country/city geolocations, and network registry data.

RUN HOST PROBE
{/* Tool 2 */}
handleToolClick('port_threat')}>

2. Port Scanner & CVE Threat Evaluator

Queries Shodan InternetDB to uncover open network ports (HTTP, SSH, FTP, DB) and flags known Common Vulnerabilities (CVEs).

RUN PORT PROBE
{/* Tool 3 */}
handleToolClick('subdomain_dns')}>

3. Subdomain Enumerator & DNS Mapping

Performs passive subdomain discovery using Certificate Transparency (CT) logs via crt.sh to map active hostnames and DNS records.

RUN ENUMERATOR
{/* Tool 4 */}
handleToolClick('dir_exposure')}>

4. Directory Bruteforce & Confidential File Probe

Inspects web roots for exposed sensitive files (`.env`, `.git`, `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`) and flags dangerous HTTP configuration leaks.

RUN DIRECTORY PROBE
{/* Tool 5 */}
handleToolClick('ssl_audit')}>

5. SSL Certificate & Security Header Auditor

Audits SSL/TLS encryption certificates for validity and verifies defensive HTTP headers like HSTS, CSP, and X-Frame-Options.

RUN HEADER AUDIT
{/* FOOTER */}
NETSENTINEL SOC

Designed for security analysts and penetration testers to execute authorized threat reconnaissance operations.
